defect_title: Distributor sales has blank customer IDs
description: Latest run found blank customer_id values; transaction-level identifiers are deliberately excluded from this upload.
expected_result: No blank customer_id values or an approved exception policy
likely_root_cause: Upstream source omission or an undocumented optionality rule; confirm with data owner.
business_impact: Affected transactions may not be attributable to customers and may reduce completeness of customer-level reporting.

defect_title: Customer master contains duplicate customer IDs
description: Latest run found rows participating in duplicate customer_id values; business-key semantics are not established.
expected_result: Unique customer IDs unless an approved one-to-many business rule exists
actual_result: 2525 rows participate in duplicate customer IDs
likely_root_cause: Duplicate business identifiers, source version overlap, or an incorrect key assumption are possible; not proven.
business_impact: Ambiguous customer joins may duplicate or misattribute customer-level facts.

description: Direct string comparison found unresolved IDs, but the approved sales-to-master ID mapping is unavailable. The reference check is BLOCKED and these counts are exploratory, not a confirmed defect.

likely_root_cause: Identifier-domain mismatch, missing crosswalk, or incorrect active-status mapping are hypotheses only.

description: Latest run compared 50000 source transactions with 45076 target rows and found missing source keys.
expected_result: Every in-scope source transaction appears exactly once in the mart

defect_title: Customer PAN values differ in mart
description: Latest run found customer_pan mismatches on matched transactions. The detailed values and keys are withheld; approved mapping and privacy rules are unavailable.
expected_result: PAN follows the approved source-to-mart mapping, masking, and privacy rules
actual_result: 40575 matched transaction rows differ on customer_pan
likely_root_cause: Mapping omission, privacy masking, or intentional non-persistence are possible; confirm rules before defect disposition.
business_impact: Customer-level reporting or compliance-sensitive processing may be affected if values are expected to be present; handle only under approved privacy controls.
